title.original: Risky-Bench: Probing Agentic Safety Risks under Real-World Deployment
title.zh: Risky-Bench：探究真实世界部署下的代理安全风险
title.en: Risky-Bench: Probing Agentic Safety Risks under Real-World Deployment

inclusion_reason.zh: Risky-Bench 能从通用原则生成环境特定 Rubric、任务和威胁配置，是可迁移的部署安全评测工厂。
inclusion_reason.en: Risky-Bench turns general principles into environment-specific rubrics, tasks, and threat configurations as a portable deployment-safety evaluation factory.

abstract.zh: Risky-Bench 从领域无关安全原则推导具体部署情境的安全 Rubric，并在不同威胁假设下运行真实长时程任务。
abstract.en: Risky-Bench derives deployment-specific safety rubrics from domain-agnostic principles and executes realistic long-horizon tasks under varying threat assumptions.

problem.zh: 为单一 Agent 场景手工设计的风险任务覆盖面窄，难迁移到不同工具配置，也无法系统扫描现实部署中的安全空间。
problem.en: Risk tasks hand-built for one agent setting cover little of the safety space, transfer poorly across tool configurations, and do not systematically scan real deployments.

approach.zh: 框架先用通用原则定义安全维度，再结合环境上下文生成 Rubric、任务和威胁条件，执行 Agent 后按该空间定位风险。
approach.en: General principles define safety dimensions, which are contextualized into rubrics, tasks, and threat conditions before agent execution is mapped back to the safety space.

system_design.zh: 流水线由原则库、环境/能力建模器、Rubric 与任务生成、威胁配置、交互执行和风险覆盖报告组成，可适配新部署。
system_design.en: The pipeline combines a principle library, environment/capability modeling, rubric and task generation, threat configuration, interactive execution, and coverage reporting.

key_results.zh: 在生活助理部署中，系统性扫描发现先进 Agent 仍有大量现实安全风险，并展示方法可构造成其他环境的评测。
key_results.en: In life-assistant deployments, systematic scanning uncovers substantial risks in strong agents and demonstrates a path to constructing evaluations for other environments.

limitations.zh: Rubric 完整性取决于原则解释和环境建模，适配新域仍需专家审核；摘要未证明自动生成任务能覆盖罕见高影响事件。
limitations.en: Rubric completeness depends on principle interpretation and environment modeling, new domains still need expert review, and rare high-impact events may remain uncovered.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
